response: Saved Views is available today and included in all paid plans. If you switch between the same filters, sorts, and groupings throughout the week, you can now save that exact setup and return to it in one click instead of rebuilding it each time. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to set up different perspectives for planning, reporting, daily standups, or tracking specific priorities across your projects. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone can work from the same configuration without manually recreating filters, keeping reports consistent and reducing the back-and-forth of explaining how a board or list should be set up. Whether you manage a small team or a larger organization, Saved Views helps you spend less time configuring your workspace and more time getting things done. It works across boards and lists, adapting to however your team organizes its work. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
